title: How can I keep loading racks from blocking airflow in a recirculating-air bogie-hearth furnace?
summary: When comparing recirculating-air bogie-hearth furnaces, assess how fully loaded racks obstruct openings and ventilation space, rather than counting fans alone. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s RT4-320-5 proposal dated 26 September 2024 includes three circulation fans, a loading rack, perforated plates, adjustable lower air plates and three-zone control. Map actual airflow obstruction to temperature-measurement positions before comparing circulation and controls.
